name: Utopian virtual
summary: Crisp, unreal early 3D graphics: glossy blue spheres, clean water, white interfaces and smooth sky gradients. Musician James Ferraro coined the term in 2011. It later came to be tied to the Frutiger Aero look.

philosophy.core_thesis: A virtual life with no flaws: clean, bright and synthetic, a soundtrack and a picture of a computer world that is too perfect to be real.
design_principles: Use one glossy 3D render as the focal image, such as a sphere, a drop or a glass button, at 40% to 60% of the viewport.
Set a vertical sky gradient from deep blue (#1E6FD9) to pale aqua (#CFF4FF) behind the render.
Give each surface a top highlight of 40% white and a soft bottom reflection of 15% white.
Use white panels with a 12px radius and a 1px pale-blue edge for content, with dark navy text.
Set headlines in a clean humanist sans-serif at normal tracking, in mixed case.
Keep body text at 17px with a contrast of 7:1 or more on white panels.
Add one small touch of fresh green (#7ED957) or lime to a single button or label.
anti_patterns: Dark purple grounds and neon glow
Heavy outlines and flat cel colours
Irony in the copy that shows through a harsh layout

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid with 24px gutters; the render sits across columns 1 to 6 and a white panel sits across columns 7 to 12.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 40% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24 and 48px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush-left text with the render floating at the right; objects cast a faint reflection below them.
layout.container_geometry: Panels with a 12px radius and a 1px pale edge; circles for buttons and spheres; capsules for tags.

font_pairings.note: A friendly humanist pair that echoes early 2000s interfaces.
A clean modern display face with a neutral text face.
A wide, open display face with a plain text face.

typography.tracking: Display takes 0em; labels take 0.08em; body stays at 0em.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and semibold (600).
Put the most important word of a heading in the primary blue.

color.palette_structure: Sky blue and aqua with white, one fresh green and a deep navy for text.
color.contrast_rules: Navy text on white or pale aqua holds at least 7:1; blue and green carry buttons and highlights, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: Smooth gradients with a gloss highlight on the top half of each object; a faint mirrored reflection below.
color.light_and_shadow: A soft white highlight at the top edge and a blurred blue shadow of 16px below; no hard shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: Early rendered glass, water and plastic: crisp spheres, droplets, glossy buttons and clear panels.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px pale-blue edge on panels; a 1px white inner edge on glossy buttons.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Soft shadows of 12px to 20px blur at 15% blue; panels lift by 4px on hover.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Filled glossy icons at 24px with round forms and a highlight, in blue and white.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Rendered spheres, water drops, glass buttons, clouds and a clean horizon; no photos of people.

motion.transition_physics: Smooth and weightless: objects float up and down by 8px over 6s; panels fade and rise by 12px over 360ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the gloss highlight by 10% and lifts the panel by 4px; active state dims the gloss by 15%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels calm wonder at a clean, perfect, synthetic world.

use_cases: music and art releases about digital life
fashion and product drops with a clean tone
avoid_when: The page needs a grainy, human or hand-made tone.
The audience wants a dark, moody tone.
The page must load fast on weak devices with large renders.

modifiers.how: Swap the sky gradient for pink to cyan on a purple ground; add a perspective floor and desktop windows.
Add a green hill, bubbles and a lighter sky; keep the gloss and soften the renders.
Replace the renders with a faded photo of an empty hall; mute the blue to peach and teal.

pack.why: Filled round icons sit well in a glossy circle and suit a clean, rendered look.

ground.why: Utopian virtual shows a clean rendered sky with a smooth gradient behind its glossy objects.

tailwind.classes: rounded-xl border border-[#7ED957] bg-[#1E6FD9] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[#CFF4FF]
